function.description: The agent wallet's own token holdings on ONE chain, USD-valued, with explicit coverage. Holdings on other chains are NOT included — ask per chain. Reveals own funds — treated as high-impact. For SOMEONE ELSE's wallet use wallet_holdings.
function.name: defi_data_portfolio

account.description: Optional (069 v4) — report the holdings of the token-bound ERC-6551 account of an NFT this treasury OWNS instead of the treasury's (a pinned collection only; needs AGENT_NFT_ENABLED).

chain.description: Chain to report holdings on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

nft.description: Optional — the same as `account`, naming the NFT: '<collection>#<id>' or '<id>'.
